topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't believe it. All that planning, all those promises, and now this. They said it was going to be the best surprise, something I'd never forget. Well, they were right about that, weren’t they? Now I'm supposed to just accept that it’s all off? Just like that, with some half-baked excuse about timing and schedules? What a joke. I put in so much effort, made sure every detail was perfect, and now I’m left with nothing. They messed up, and they expect me to just let it slide? Not a chance.
